sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Certification and Security Auditing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Chinese Mainland (PRC) as WFOE incorporation seat; Taiwan as the non-resident investor domicile
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Socialist legal system with civil law tradition; codified statutes, administrative regulations and SAMR rule-making)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Investment Protection and Promotion Law for Taiwan Compatriots (1994, as amended 2016 and 2019) and its Implementing Rules
Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) signed 29 June 2010
Cross-Strait Agreement on the Use and Verification of Notarized Documents signed 29 April 1993, effective 3 May 1993
Cross-Strait Financial Cooperation Agreement signed 16 November 2009
Cross-Strait Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement signed 25 August 2015 but not in force; no active DTAA between the Chinese Mainland and Taiwan

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 Revision, adopted 8 November 2024, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC and SAMR Joint Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024); PRC Company Law (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law (effective 1 January 2020) and the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures; Taiwan Compatriots Investment Protection Law (1994, amended 2016 and 2019); Measures for the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration (SAMR Order No. 34 [2021]); PBOC Customer Due Diligence and KYC Management Measures (PBOC Order No. 1 [2018]); SAFE FDI status registration and capital account reporting rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Taiwan investor certificate of incorporation, current company registration record and full change history (公司登記證明書及歷次變更登記表)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs business registration authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization Verification Protocol: notarization at a Taiwan district court notary office or licensed private notary, SEF/ARATS certified-copy transmission, and verification certificate issued by the provincial Notary Association on the Chinese Mainland; Hague Apostille and consular legalization are NOT applicable because Taiwan is not an Apostille contracting state and no PRC consular post exists in Taiwan

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney and proxy letter appointing the WFOE legal representative, local registration agent and counsel (授權書及委託書)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan investor board of directors or shareholders meeting
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization Verification Protocol as described above; notarized signature verification required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copies of Taiwan investor identification documents, seal registration certificate (印鑑證明), company charter, and national IDs or passports of executing shareholder representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan district court notary office, private notary and household registration office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Notarization Verification Protocol; each set transmitted via SEF/ARATS channel and verified by the provincial Notary Association

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank credit reference letter and source-of-funds statement for the committed registered capital (銀行資信證明及出資資金來源聲明)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization at a Taiwan notary followed by Cross-Strait Notarization Verification Protocol; apostille expressly inapplicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Independent AML/CFT pre-incorporation screening report covering PEP, sanctions and UBO tracing to natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Retained PRC compliance consultant or licensed counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal work product; no notarization required but must be retained in the corporate due diligence file for inspection by PBOC, SAMR or customs auditors

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all applicants, shareholders, directors, supervisors and ultimate beneficial owners against the PBOC national AML/CFT monitoring list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions as implemented by PRC authorities, OFAC SDN and SSI lists for USD-denominated wire transfers via correspondent banks under the target payment rails (Wire Transfer and Wise), EU and UK consolidated sanctions where EU/UK counterparties are engaged, and Taiwan competent authority enforcement lists (Taiwan FSC, MJIB and customs enforcement lists) given the Taiwan-domiciled shareholder. The 2025 PRC AML Law mandates enhanced due diligence on politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates, and on opaque legal arrangements; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation is required for any capital contribution exceeding RMB 200,000 (approximately USD 28,000); client risk tiering documentation and AML/CFT records must be retained for at least five years after the business relationship terminates.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System operated within the SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (https://www.gsxt.gov.cn); local filings submitted through provincial SAMR one-stop online service platforms, e.g. Shanghai Enterprise Registration Online (一網通辦) or the equivalent city-level portal where the WFOE is incorporated
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be composed exclusively of standardized Simplified Chinese characters and must follow the mandatory statutory sequence of administrative-region plus distinctive name plus industry-or-operational feature plus legal form suffix. A minimum of two Chinese characters is required for the distinctive name segment. Pinyin or English transliterations may be used commercially as auxiliary trade names but confer no formal name protection and cannot be filed in the SAMR name database. For an ISIC 7020 management-consulting entity, the industry segment must truthfully reflect consulting, audit advisory or supply-chain security advisory activity
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 中国, 中华, 全国, 国家, 中央 (require express approval from the State Administration for Market Regulation at central level)
银行, 证券, 保险, 基金, 支付, 金融 (require financial regulator pre-approval)
集团 (requires an existing parent group holding structure)
国际 (generally refused for newly established enterprises without a verifiable foreign parent)
台湾, 两岸, 海峽 (politically sensitive tokens triggering special administrative review and subject to refusal as a matter of policy)

海关, 認證, 認可, 檢驗, 檢疫, AEO, 安全 (sensitive tokens implying governmental certification authority; the token 認證 may be permitted only where the company charter strictly limits activity to consulting rather than issuing certificates; AEO-related tokens may require a non-objection note from the General Administration of Customs where the company intends to provide AEO advisory services)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon automated or manual rejection, the applicant shall (1) within 15 working days file a written review application with the same SAMR registration authority stating the lawful interest, non-collision and non-misleading character of the proposed name; (2) if the review is dismissed, file administrative reconsideration with the superior SAMR within 60 days or initiate administrative litigation within 6 months; (3) in parallel, rebid a secondary name variant after executing a fresh pre-clearance conflict search against the SAMR database and the CTMO trademark registry across relevant Nice classes so as not to stall the incorporation timeline; (4) in the event of rejection based on sensitive tokens, either remove the token or petition the competent ministerial authority for express pre-approval before resubmission; all rejection decisions should be logged in the due diligence file because they may evidence trademark or trade-name conflict risk requiring a separate legal opinion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Limited acceptance subject to FTZ rules: cluster registration (集群註冊) is statutorily admissible only inside designated free-trade zones and innovation parks and only for qualifying service businesses. An ISIC 7020 management-consulting entity qualifies in such parks on condition that (1) the park operator maintains a physical service window and the company retains a verifiable lease or service contract with the operator, (2) the entity establishes a physical management coordination office within 6 months if customs-facing or AEO-related documentary storage obligations require it, and (3) no mailbox-only address outside an FTZ is used. A virtual-only office outside a pilot FTZ for a non-e-commerce company should be treated as unenforceable and may trigger deregistration scrutiny under the 2021 Name Registration Measures and the SAMR anti-fraud address inspection program.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Approximately 10-15% annual probability of unannounced on-site verification by the local SAMR or tax authority; probability escalates to 25-30% if invoice issuance is detected before physical address confirmation or if abnormal address-change notifications are filed. Inspections for a consulting-only entity are typically documentary (verification of business license display, lease in force, staff presence and signage) but the registered office must nonetheless be staffed and identifiable during statutory business hours.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the Taiwan investor corporate registration certificates and full change history at a Taiwan district court notary office or licensed private notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Taiwan Notary Act fee schedule (公證法規費收費標準)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-strait transmission of certified notarial copies through the SEF/ARATS channel (公證書副本寄送)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) and Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Service fee benchmark under the 1993 Cross-Strait Agreement on the Use and Verification of Notarized Documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Verification and issuance of the notarial-certificate verification certificate (公證書查證及核驗證明) by the provincial Notary Association on the Chinese Mainland
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial or city Notary Association where the WFOE will be registered
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary association published tariff (RMB 200-800 per certificate set)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise name self-service declaration and automated clearance screening (企業名稱自主申報)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) municipal registration office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee under the 2021 Measures for the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: WFOE establishment registration and business license issuance (設立登記及營業執照)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local SAMR market entity registration authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State Council fee-exemption policy; enterprise registration fees abolished since January 2017

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Engraving of statutory company seal set (company seal, finance seal, tax invoice seal and legal representative seal)
Registered office prepayment - first-year cluster-registration service address in an FTZ innovation park
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: FTZ innovation park operator or designated cluster registration agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for pilot FTZ cluster address (approximately RMB 12,000 per annum)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Opening of basic deposit settlement account at a mainland commercial bank with RMB and USD wire capability, including bank-level screening tests for Wire Transfer and Wise payment rails
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial bank (Bank of China, ICBC or equivalent cross-border account unit)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank published tariff benchmark (account opening fee USD 0-50)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAFE foreign exchange registration for foreign-invested entity establishment (FDI status registration) and capital account documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) acting through the delegated bank
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee charged by SAFE; service bundled within the bank tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-border legal due diligence, UBO piercing analysis, drafting of Articles of Association, shareholders resolutions and the WFOE establishment legal opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained PRC law firm licensed to practice cross-border investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for Taiwan-invested WFOE incorporation (RMB 18,000-25,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration agency service covering the full cross-strait WFOE filing sequence (name declaration, business scope finalization, license pickup, tax registration, invoice quota application and seal registration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed business registration agency (工商註冊代理)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT compliance and UBO registration setup - beneficial owner information filing under PBOC and SAMR Joint Order No. 3 [2024], internal control manual and PEP/sanctions screening protocol implementation
Multi-license integration follow-up (tax registration, social insurance registration and statistical reporting enrollment under the multi-certificate integration regime)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Tax authority, human resources and social security authority and statistics authority, coordinated through the agency

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: PRC Company Law (2018 Revision), Articles 23, 29, 31, 32, 33, and 37; Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2020), Articles 6, 28, and 32; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (2021), Chapter II.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) acting through the local Municipal/Provincial Market Regulation Administration where the registered office is located.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application Form for Establishment Registration of a Limited Liability Company, together with the Articles of Association and the Capital Contribution Confirmation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to management consulting under PRC law. Registered capital is subscribed in full in the Articles of Association; the paid-in amount must be contributed within the schedule agreed in the Articles, and a foreign-invested WFOE must deposit the subscribed capital in a bank foreign-exchange capital account prior to or immediately after registration. No formal escrow is required, but capital remittance is subject to SAFE information reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the sole shareholder of the company, as follows: (1) the shareholder hereby subscribes to the fully registered capital set forth in the Articles of Association, and the paid-in contribution shall be placed into a temporary capital contribution account prior to registration; (2) the registered office at [●] is approved as the company's legal address, and the authorized manager is directed to execute the lease and registration documents; (3) [●] is appointed as Executive Director and legal representative, and [●] as Supervisor, each with authority to file the articles, open bank accounts, obtain the business license, and complete all requisite licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Market Regulation Administration via the National Enterprise Registration Online Service Platform (E-Login)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the provincial or municipal Enterprise Registration E-Login system, complete the name reservation with three candidate names, upload the Taiwan investor's identity documents, and submit the proposed business scope referencing ISIC 7020 management consulting and AEO supply chain security auditing. The name should follow the format: Taiwan-funded [city] [trade name] Consulting Co., Ltd.
required_dossiers: Copy of the investor's Taiwan ID card and Mainland Travel Permit
Power of attorney to the filing agent if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for duplication or prohibited wording, the system issues a rejection notice; the applicant shall re-file with a revised name or attach a written consent letter from the owner of any conflicting registered mark, and resubmit within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: FDI remittance and capital contribution confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAFE-approved commercial bank and the local Market Regulation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After name approval, open a temporary foreign exchange capital account at the designated bank. The Taiwan investor wires the subscribed registered capital from overseas, and the bank remits it into the temporary account, completes the SAFE foreign investment information registration, and issues a capital contribution confirmation certificate. The confirmation is retained for the registration filing.
required_dossiers: Investor identification and legal existence certificate
Source-of-funds declaration for anti-money laundering review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank blocks the transfer under anti-money laundering controls, the investor must provide bank statements proving lawful source and an explanation of the transaction purpose; if the bank remains unwilling to accept the remittance, select another SAFE-approved bank and resubmit the cross-border payment instruction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration one-stop establishment registration window or E-Chamber online platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic application on the E-Chamber platform, sign by verified e-signature or mobile biometric verification for the legal representative and supervisor, upload the lease, Articles, name approval, identity documents, and capital contribution certificate. The reviewing officer will verify that the business scope is outside the Foreign Investment Negative List; management consulting and AEO auditing are permitted without prior special approval.
required_dossiers: Identity certificates of the legal representative, executive director, and supervisor
Lease agreement and landlord's property ownership or building inspection certificate
Capital contribution confirmation certificate if paid before registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner issues a query or rejection, cure the defect by signing the corrected forms or uploading the supplement within ten working days through the same E-Chamber portal. For substantive mismatch of the business scope, amend the Articles and resubmit the full application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of business license and post-registration formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Market Regulation Administration (license issuance), licensed seal engraving agency, commercial bank, and local Tax Service Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the AMR issues the business license and a social credit code. The company must engage a licensed seal engraver to carve the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal; open a basic deposit account at a bank; complete social insurance registration; and perform tax registration via the electronic tax bureau, followed by monthly filing obligations.
required_dossiers: Seal registration receipt from the licensed engraver
Bank account opening application and capital transfer records
Legal representative and supervisor identity documents
Office lease and property ownership proof for tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank account opening is delayed by cross-border tax information verification, provide a certified beneficial ownership declaration and the Articles, or select another bank branch. If tax registration is queried due to a lack of business commencement, submit a written commencement notice and a copy of the lease to close the inquiry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Fire safety and occupational clearance for office premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Fire and Rescue Bureau; District office of Housing and Urban-Rural Development; no industrial permit board is engaged
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the leased office is commercial-use and covered by the building's fire protection acceptance certificate. If local rules require a fire safety self-inspection for office occupancy, complete and submit the form. Ensure two emergency exits, emergency lighting, and sufficient fire-extinguishing equipment. Verify that the building's structural load and the office wiring are compliant with the Work Safety Law and interior decoration regulations. No environmental impact assessment is triggered for office-based consulting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the landlord cannot furnish a fire protection acceptance certificate, commission a structural and fire-safety inspection by a qualified firm and resubmit the report to the Fire and Rescue Bureau; if the premises are non-compliant, relocate to a code-compliant commercial building before commencement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7020; the general administrative authority is the local Market Regulation Administration for business registration and the Fire and Rescue Bureau for physical premises clearance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General business registration (营业执照) is sufficient; no separate industrial operating or manufacturing permit is required for management consulting and AEO supply chain security auditing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China, acting through the local Municipal Ecological and Environmental Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based consulting is not listed in the Classified Management Catalogue of Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge; sanitary sewage shall be connected to the municipal sewerage system in accordance with local drainage standards. No volatile organic compound process emissions. Office hazardous waste, including used toner cartridges and batteries, must be collected by licensed recyclers. General office paper waste shall be handled through municipal sanitation and recycling services.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety acceptance certificate of the leased office building, a structural load certificate, and an emergency evacuation inspection must be obtained. The premises must comply with the Law of the PRC on Work Safety and the Fire Protection Law, including operable emergency exits, unobstructed corridors, and installed fire extinguishers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China (国家稅務總局); official portal: www.chinatax.gov.cn; electronic tax bureau: etax.chinatax.gov.cn with provincial instances. For Taiwan-side counterparty matters: Taiwan Ministry of Finance (財政部) and regional National Taxation Bureaus, e-tax portal: etax.nat.gov.tw.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the WFOE limited liability company through the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) one-stop registration; the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (統一社會信用代碼) printed on the business license (營業執照) is the statutory TIN and VAT ID. Step 2: Complete supplementary tax registration in the e-Tax Bureau within 30 days of license issuance, including legal representative, financial controller, banking accounts, accounting method and taxpayer-type election. Step 3: Elect VAT status: small-scale taxpayer (annual taxable sales at or below RMB 5,000,000) or general VAT taxpayer (mandatory above RMB 5,000,000 and required for input VAT credits and export refunds). Step 4: Obtain customs registration as an import/export enterprise through the China International Trade Single Window, acquiring the 10-digit customs code, electronic port IC card and AEO facilitation profile. Step 5: Open a foreign exchange settlement account at a designated bank, register with SAFE for trade-in-foreign-exchange monitoring, and activate the export tax refund (出口退免稅) filing module in the e-Tax Bureau. Step 6: For services supplied to Taiwan or other overseas recipients, file the cross-border zero-rating or VAT exemption record with the local STA and retain service delivery and consumption evidence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 2, taxed on worldwide income at 25%; no pass-through or check-the-box eligibility exists for Chinese LLCs. Territorial scope: the WFOE is taxed on China-source income and offshore income; non-resident counterparties such as a Taiwan parent or customer are taxed on China-source income by withholding, generally 10% but potentially reduced under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement effective for 2017 onward. A free trade zone location does not create a tax-exempt zone; only selective preferential regimes such as encouraged-industry 15% rates apply, which are not assumed here.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC law provides no check-the-box or hybrid entity classification election; all WFOE LLCs are entity-level taxpayers. Available statutory elections: (a) VAT status election between small-scale simplified levy (currently 1% or 3%) and general taxpayer treatment (6%, 9%, 13% with input VAT credits) when annual taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000; (b) export tax refund mechanism election: exemption-offset-refund (免抵退) for production and qualifying service exporters versus levy-then-refund for trading companies; (c) cross-border service treatment election between zero-rating for statutory offshore outsourcing, software, R&D and information-system services and VAT exemption for certification-consulting and audit-type services under CaiShui 2016 No. 36 Annex 4; (d) treaty benefits application under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement to cap Taiwan withholding rates on dividends at 5% (for beneficial owners holding at least 25% capital with substance), interest at 10% and royalties at 10%; (e) enterprise income tax elections such as R&D super-deduction (additional 100% deduction) and advanced-technology-service enterprise status at 15%. Hybrid mismatch arrangements are constrained by the general anti-avoidance rule (EIT Law Articles 47-48) and special tax adjustment rules; no elective hybrid-mismatch safe harbor exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT, 增值稅) under the PRC VAT law framework, supplemented by consumption tax on specific goods; Taiwan counterparty transactions may also touch Taiwan Gross Business Receipts Tax (營業稅) at 5%.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic-nexus turnover threshold exempts an incorporated WFOE from VAT registration; registration is compulsory at incorporation. The operative threshold is general VAT taxpayer registration: annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 (approximately USD 690,000) mandate general taxpayer status with standard rates and input VAT credits; at or below RMB 5,000,000, small-scale simplified treatment at 1% or 3% may be elected, but it disqualifies the entity from claiming input credits and export tax refunds. Foreign suppliers without a PRC establishment that provide services into China are subject to VAT withholding by the PRC payor, and Taiwan suppliers rendering services into Mainland China through the WFOE engagement are subject to the same reverse-charge or withholding mechanism.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates the fully digital e-Fapiao (數電票) system deployed nationally through the e-Tax Bureau; legacy tax control equipment is being phased out. All VAT invoices require real-time issuance with authority pre-assigned invoice quotas, digital stamping or digital signature, and immediate transmission to the Golden Tax Phase IV (金稅四期) clearance engine. Taxpayers may generate invoices through the web portal or certified API integration; Golden Tax IV automatically cross-matches invoice data with China International Trade Single Window customs declarations, bank foreign-exchange settlement records and corporate registration data. For export transactions, the zero-rated e-Fapiao must reference the customs export declaration number and be matched to the customs release manifest; discrepancies trigger real-time exception reporting, refund holds and audit flags.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods: the WFOE must hold general VAT taxpayer status, be the named exporter on the customs export declaration, ensure physical departure from the PRC customs territory, receive matching export proceeds in foreign currency, and issue the zero-rated export e-Fapiao; the exported goods must have previously borne genuine input VAT that is creditable. For offshore services including AEO certification, security auditing and consulting supplied to Taiwan or other overseas recipients and consumed entirely outside Mainland China: statutory zero-rating applies only to enumerated categories such as offshore service outsourcing, business process management, software, R&D and information-system services; certification-consulting and audit-type services generally qualify for VAT exemption rather than 0%, meaning no output VAT is charged and associated input VAT is non-reclaimable unless the engagement is restructured as zero-rated offshore service outsourcing (離岸服務外包) satisfying trade-in-services classification and delivery documentation. Substantiation must demonstrate that the recipient is outside the PRC and that the benefit and performance occur wholly offshore, evidenced by contemporaneous contracts, delivery records, communications and intellectual-property usage logs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口報關單) bearing the electronic release record and customs declaration number
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (海運提單或空運單) proving dispatch from a PRC port and arrival outside Mainland China
Inward Remittance Certificate / Export Proceeds Collection Record (銀行收匯水單或涉外收入申報單) issued by the settlement bank or SAFE monitoring system
Zero-rated or VAT-exempt e-Fapiao generated through the digital e-invoice platform
Export sales contract, packing list and weight memo, plus customs inspection or AEO security-audit documentation where goods are subject to statutory inspection
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are subject to ex-post desk audits and Golden Tax Phase IV data forensics. False or inflated claims trigger: (a) administrative clawback of refunded VAT and exempted tax, daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05%, and fines between 50% and five times the tax evaded under the Tax Collection Administration Law Articles 63-66; (b) criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 204 (fraudulent export tax refund) and Article 205 (false issuance of special VAT invoices), with imprisonment of up to five years for significant amounts, five to ten years for huge amounts or serious circumstances, and up to life imprisonment for especially huge amounts or especially serious circumstances; (c) customs enforcement including revocation of customs registration or AEO certification for up to three years and joint blacklisting under the customs-tax memoranda; (d) a five-year statutory audit look-back period with no time limitation for fraud, together with cross-strait tax and customs information exchange under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement and customs cooperation framework. Any false representation in AEO security-audit reports additionally exposes the WFOE to professional disciplinary action, client-jurisdiction licensing suspension and contractual indemnity claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) is the sovereign monetary authority of the People's Republic of China; the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) is the PBOC-affiliated central foreign-exchange regulator and exercises delegated authority over currency convertibility, current-account verification, capital-account registration, financial-institution FX retail business, and cross-border payment statistics. All regulatory requirements for a mainland China WFOE funded from Taiwan must be resolved against PBOC AML/KYC rules and SAFE foreign-exchange directives.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB (CNY) is fully convertible on the current account in law for genuine trade in goods and services, including consulting, certification, and AEO security-audit fees. Convertibility is administrative rather than free: banks must verify the underlying transaction through SAFE trade-in-services and trade-in-goods monitoring systems, and any single service-trade outward payment exceeding USD 50,000 requires an advance Service Trade and Other Cross-Border Payments Tax Filing Form (税务备案表) accepted by the local tax authority. The capital account remains non-convertible absent registration: FDI capital contributions must be registered with SAFE through a designated bank, paid into a dedicated Capital Escrow Account, and used within a negative list that excludes securities investment, wealth-management purchases, entrusted loans, non-business real estate, and equity reinvestment outside the registered scope. Profit remittance (dividends) is treated as a current-account outward item but is practically conditional on audited statutory financial statements evidencing distributable reserves, a valid profit-distribution resolution, verified settlement of corporate income tax and the 10% withholding tax on the Taiwan non-resident corporate shareholder, and presentation of the FDI foreign-exchange registration voucher to the remitting bank. Accumulated losses, unresolved tax arrears, an unreconciled capital account, or a negative-list mismatch will block the remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's trade-in-goods aggregate-verification framework, export proceeds arising from customs-cleared goods must be repatriated into a domestic current-account foreign-exchange account rather than retained offshore; for spot receivables the general compliance expectation is collection within 90 days after export declaration, and for registered usance transactions within the contractual maturity, reported through the enterprise trade monitoring system. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio into RMB: the former forced-surrender quotas were abolished in 2012, and A/B-class enterprises may elect between retaining foreign exchange in a current-account forex account or settling into RMB on a voluntary-settlement (意愿结汇) basis against verified underlying trade items. C-class enterprises and entities flagged for overdue receipts, mismatched customs data, or AML red flags are downgraded, subjected to list-based verification, and may be required to settle foreign exchange compulsorily. For this WFOE, the primary service receipts are trade-in-services fees rather than goods-export proceeds, so the goods-trade surrender mechanics apply only to any incidental customs/AEO-advisory fees tied to physical export documentation; pure consulting fees are verified under the trade-in-services regime instead.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority_note: PBOC and SAFE operate the China Foreign Exchange Trade System and CIPS clearing infrastructure; the designated receiving bank acts as the de facto SAFE registration agent for FDI and external-debt matters under the streamlined bank-mediated registration procedure introduced in 2019/2020.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance (管轄國稅局) of the registered tax jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 to May 31 following the calendar year end; automatic one-month extension to June 30 where the return is prepared and signed by a certified public accountant; provisional tax for the current half-year is due by September 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% of tax per month (max 5 months); understatement penalty 2x evaded tax (up to 3x for fraud) plus daily interest at the postal one-year deposit rate; tax authority may assess on available evidence after the deadline, order suspension of operations, and ultimately revoke tax registration, which extinguishes VAT invoicing and customs AEO-operating capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Unappropriated Earnings Surtax Return (未分配盈餘申報; 5% surtax on undistributed profits)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance (管轄國稅局)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 to May 31 following the year in which the shareholders' meeting resolves the earnings distribution; filed concurrently with the annual CIT return; CPA extension to June 30 applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Same surcharge, interest, and enforcement regime as the CIT return; the surtax base is increased by any undistributed portion not properly declared; a 30-day payment demand precedes coercive collection against corporate assets and bank accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Meeting Approval of Financial Statements, Business Report, and Profit Appropriation (年度財務報表、營業報告書及盈餘分派承認)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate statutory records (kept at the registered office); not filed with the registry unless paid-in capital exceeds the NT$30 million CPA-audit threshold or Articles are amended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year end, i.e., by June 30 for calendar-year companies; written shareholder consent is permissible for limited-liability companies without a board
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act administrative fines on responsible officers (approximately USD 320-16,000 per violation); unapproved financial statements block lawful dividend distribution and undermine the undistributed-earnings surtax filing; persistent default after MOEA's rectification order may trigger an order of dissolution/registration revocation under Company Act Article 10.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Substantial Beneficial Owner Register Update and MOEA Filing (實質受益人資料申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs - Company Registration System (or the municipal Economic Development Bureau where registered in a special municipality)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial filing within 15 days of incorporation; updates filed within 15 days of any change in ownership, control, or beneficial interest (including share transfers effected after the annual meeting); no standalone annual renewal filing is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: AML-regime administrative fines of up to approximately USD 16,000 (NT$500,000) per violation; subsequent company registration changes are rejected until the SBO register is corrected; knowingly false SBO declarations can attract criminal money-laundering penalties; inspection by MOEA and law-enforcement agencies is permitted at any time.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Business Operation Report (外商投資事業營運狀況年度申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission (Investment Review Commission), Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (經濟部投資審議司)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by May 31 following the reporting year (calendar-year basis), reflecting the audited/approved annual financial data (paid-in capital, revenue, profit, shareholding structure)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unreported or inconsistent foreign-investment data may trigger Commission compliance review, suspension of preferred remittance/earnings-repatriation facilitation, and delay or denial of reinvestment or expansion approval; continuing default may restrict the foreign-investment approval and cause unapproved equity transfers to be void.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit of financial statements mandatory if paid-in capital ≥ NT$30 million (≈ USD 1.0 million) (Company Act Article 20); CPA-attested annual CIT return mandatory if annual business revenue plus non-operating income ≥ NT$50 million (approx. USD 1.6 million) (Income Tax Act); public companies and financial institutions are audited under FSC-mandated IFRS and additional circulars.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: ROC Enterprise Accounting Standards (EAS) for non-public enterprises; IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) for public companies; the WFOE may elect full IFRS; statutory financial statements are prepared in New Taiwan Dollars and Chinese language.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan imposes a continuous SBO-accuracy duty rather than a separate annual confirmation: SBO data must be filed with the MOEA registry within 15 days of incorporation and within 15 days of every change in beneficial ownership, including post-transfer shareholding changes; at each annual shareholders' meeting the board must verify the SBO register against the updated shareholding records and file any resulting amendments with the MOEA within 15 days; the company must retain SBO records for at least 5 years and produce them to MOEA or law-enforcement upon lawful demand.
